data.statement: Increase the AI settings maximum request timeout from 3600 seconds to 12 hours for overnight local model runs, and analyze whether the timeout implementation can detect that the model is still working through polling or progress interrogation.

acceptance: The AI Settings timeout field accepts and persists 65535 seconds; focused tests prove the new cap; settings validation still repairs invalid non-positive values without clamping valid positive timeouts; documentation explains that current provider calls are blocking and that streaming or idle-timeout support would be a separate enhancement.
data.reason: The user supplied the cap and scope is limited to settings UI, focused tests, and documentation; no policy-sensitive or medium-risk open question remains.
scope: In scope: raise the AI Settings timeout control cap to 65535 seconds, add focused tests for the cap/persistence behavior, and update relevant component documentation about timeout behavior and the current non-streaming progress limitation. Out of scope for this slice: implementing streaming chat completions, partial JSON persistence, provider-specific job polling, or UI progress semantics for streamed token activity.
data.understanding: Increase the AI Settings request-timeout cap from the current UI limit of 3600 seconds to 65535 seconds so local large-context model runs can be left running overnight, while preserving existing settings validation and current non-streaming OpenAI-compatible request behavior. The implementation should also document the current limitation: AudioMancer waits on a blocking chat-completions response, so it cannot reliably interrogate per-request progress unless a future streaming or backend-specific progress design is added.

data.summary: Focused AI Settings timeout-cap test fails because the timeout spinbox maximum is still 3600 instead of 65535.
Focused AI Settings timeout-cap and settings-validation tests pass for the 65535-second overnight timeout contract.

data.rationale: Lets operators leave large-context local model requests running overnight without editing settings files by hand.
data.requirement: AI Settings Page shall allow the LLM request timeout to be configured up to 65535 seconds and persist that value through the normal settings build flow.
